in_sanskrit.name: Dawa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Gift of God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dawa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dawa is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'dāna', which means 'gift'. In Hindu mythology, Dawa represents the divine gift of knowledge or wisdom bestowed upon the devotee. This name is often given to a child born into a religious or scholarly family, as it is believed to bring blessings of knowledge and wisdom.
